quarterly_data.signal: Applied's 10-Q segment table for the nine months ended July 26, 2026: Semiconductor Systems revenue was $18,146 million versus $16,562 million in the nine months ended July 27, 2025 (gross margin 54.8% vs 53.4%), and Applied Global Services revenue was $5,005 million versus $4,236 million. Foundry and logic spending rose on stronger demand for leading-edge manufacturing technologies, partly offset over the nine months by lower demand for trailing-edge logic systems, and memory spending rose on increased customer investments in DRAM technology transitions.
